name: dataProvider
description: Returns the layer's raster data provider, which handles data access and band manipulation.

name: width
description: Returns the raster width in pixels (number of columns).

name: height
description: Returns the raster height in pixels (number of rows).

name: bandCount
description: Returns the number of bands (layers) in the raster dataset.

name: dataType
description: Returns the data type of the specified band (e.g., Byte, Int16, Float32).

name: renderer
description: Returns the current raster renderer used for displaying the layer.

name: setRenderer
description: Sets a custom raster renderer for the layer (e.g., singleband gray, multispectral, paletted).

name: extent
description: Returns the spatial extent (bounding box) of the raster layer.

name: crs
description: Returns the coordinate reference system of the raster layer.

name: subsetString
description: Returns the current SQL subset string (where clause) used to mask pixels.

name: setSubsetString
description: Sets an SQL subset string to mask pixels. Only pixels matching the expression are rendered.

name: clone
description: Creates a deep copy of the raster layer with the same source and properties.
